confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Manila price levels, not live menus or listings; no city-price web sources were used. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors vary widely by district (Malate and Ermita versus Makati and BGC), so treat them as central estimates. Cocktail and wine anchors rest mainly on the local beer price relationship because direct price knowledge is weaker for them; that is the stated basis for those two values. Assumes July 2026 (rainy season) pricing.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other large Southeast Asian capitals with similar tourist accommodation tiers (for example Bangkok and Ho Chi Minh City), adjusted for Manila's inexpensive local eating, its district-driven hotel spread, and a moderate bar price level.
